Quick calc attached. Assumptions: H100 hourly list = $20/hr (reserved), on-demand = $28/hr. Proposed temporary overage discount = 25% off on-demand rate for overage capacity, capped at $30,000 for the first 90 days.

Worst-case exposure (they burn +4 GPUs continuously for 14 days):
- Additional compute hours: 4 GPUS * 24 hr/day * 14 days = 1344 GPU-hours
- Discounted savings vs list: (28 - 28*0.75) = $7/hr discounted benefit per GPU -> total discount exposure = 1344 * 7 = $9,408

That fits comfortably inside our $30k cap. If they sustain bursts beyond 14 days, deal should auto-fallback to standard overage rates.

Recommendation: Approve reservation hold (14 days) and a capped 25% overage discount up to $30k for the first 90 days, conditional on signed PO within 14 days and addendum that specifies fallback and monitoring hooks. Legal (Rishi) to create short addendum draft.

Marissa Cole
Finance, Redwood Inference

Emma —

Thanks for the details and for the capacity plan. We can accommodate BrightHealth's request with the following executive-approved exceptions: 

1) Reservation hold: Redwood will hold the requested 8 H100 GPUs in us-west for up to 14 calendar days without billing while procurement completes the PO. After 14 days the reservation will be released unless a PO or written commitment is received.

2) Temporary overage pricing: For the first 90 days after start of the POC (start date to be defined in the addendum), BrightHealth will receive a 25% discount on overage on-demand rates, capped at $30,000 total. Any overage that would result in charges beyond the cap will be billed at standard overage rates.

3) Conditions: a) PO required within 14 days of this approval to trigger hold; b) Redwood will monitor burst usage and reserve the right to throttle or move workload in the event of sustained, continuous capacity consumption that affects other customers; c) H100 assignment subject to ops confirmation at time of reservation activation.

Rishi will circulate a short addendum to capture the above and the PO details. Tom (CloudPartner) — please confirm any partner-managed provisioning requirements.
